description: Use this when the user pastes a MemoryRouter share link (app.memoryrouter.ai/transfer/...) with its password and asks to import it. The first call (no confirmation) only shows who shared it and how many memories it holds, and imports nothing. After the user confirms, call again with the same link and password and the exact confirmation phrase to copy the memories into the connected vault. Importing is free. For a large share, call again with the same arguments until it reports complete.

confirmation.description: Exact phrase, only after the user has seen the summary and confirmed.

link.description: The share link, or just its token.

name: import_memory_share
title: Import a memory share link
